This file mirrors the KWin private protocol used by Plasma's Global Menu applet. Source of truth: https://invent.kde.org/plasma/kwin/-/blob/master/src/wayland/protocols/appmenu.xml

interface.name: org_kde_kwin_appmenu_manager
interface.description: This interface allows a client to link a window (or wl_surface) to an address on the D-Bus containing a DBusMenu-compatible interface.

request.name: create

description.summary: Create AppMenu handle for a surface

request.description: Create a new appmenu handle for a surface. The address is provided later via set_address.

interface.name: org_kde_kwin_appmenu
interface.description: The DBus service name and object path where the appmenu interface is present. The path can be nested to any depth.

request.name: set_address

description.summary: Set DBus address for the menu

request.description: Set address of the D-Bus service exposing com.canonical.dbusmenu.

description.summary: Release the memory for this object
